property_summary: For any clone-style calldata whose trailing two bytes encode a valid immutable-args offset, C.owner() must return the 20-byte address embedded at immutable-arg offset 0x0; the mutant reads offset 0x3c (past the calldata, yielding zero) and so returns the wrong address for any nonzero embedded address.
change_summary: Read the immutable arg at offset 0x3c (factory address) instead of 0x0, so owner() returns the factory address.
